step.name: Product name
step.removeConfirmBody: It comes off your routine. Your streak stays as it is.

expect.retinoid: Give it 8–12 weeks before judging. Dryness or stinging in the first few weeks is common. Not recommended in pregnancy.
expect.acid: Skin often feels smoother in 2–4 weeks. It can sting at first and makes skin more sun-sensitive, so wear sunscreen.
expect.benzoyl: Spots usually start to calm in 2–4 weeks, with the full effect around 8–12. It can dry skin and bleach towels and pillowcases.
expect.azelaic: Expect about 4 weeks for redness and spots, and around 12 for dark marks. A tingle at first is normal.
expect.vitaminC: Give it 8–12 weeks for brightness and marks. It keeps best cool and dark, and turns brown as it goes off.
expect.niacinamide: Give it 4–8 weeks for redness, oil and marks. Gentle for most skin.
expect.sunscreen: Protects from the first day. Dark marks only fade with sunscreen every day, so this is what makes your other steps work.
expect.moisture: Works the same day: skin feels softer and less tight.

step.stingsBody: A mild tingle for a minute can be normal. Burning, swelling or redness that lasts isn't: rinse it off, stop using it, and see a pharmacist or doctor if it keeps happening.
step.stingsEase: Most skin gets used to it in a few weeks. Using it every other night, with moisturiser first, often helps.
